label: Identify subject
description: Find who or what the sentence is about, ignoring opening phrases.

label: Identify head noun
description: Find the main noun inside a longer subject noun phrase.

label: Subject number
description: Decide whether the subject is singular or plural.

label: Regular verbs
description: Choose regular present-tense verbs that agree with the subject.

label: Be verbs
description: Choose am, is, are, was, or were according to subject and time.

label: Verb phrases
description: Choose helping verb phrases that agree with the subject.

label: Information before noun
description: Use the head noun when extra information appears before it.

label: Information after noun
description: Use the head noun when extra information appears after it.

label: Relative clauses
description: Ignore relative clauses when deciding which verb agrees with the subject.

label: And / or subjects
description: Handle compound subjects joined by and or or.
